scripts.check: pnpm format:check && turbo run lint typecheck test build
scripts.format: oxfmt --write package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml turbo.json tsconfig.base.json apps/api packages
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml turbo.json tsconfig.base.json apps/api packages
scripts.titan:check: pnpm titan:lint && pnpm titan:typecheck && pnpm titan:test && pnpm titan:test:postgres
scripts.titan:lint: uv run --project services/titan ruff check services/titan
scripts.titan:test: uv run --project services/titan python -m unittest discover -s services/titan/tests -v
scripts.titan:typecheck: uv run --project services/titan mypy --config-file services/titan/pyproject.toml services/titan/titan
scripts.verify: pnpm check && pnpm test:database && pnpm titan:check && pnpm generated:check && pnpm mons:check
scripts.mons:build:ios: xcodebuild build -quiet -project apps/mons/mons.xcodeproj -scheme mons -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
scripts.mons:check: pnpm mons:test:packages && pnpm mons:build:ios && pnpm mons:test
